messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.

Notes from Tuesday: Priya will draft the pricing page by Friday. Marcus is blocked on the SSO vendor and will escalate. We agreed to postpone the mobile launch to November so QA has two full weeks. Next sync is Thursday at 10.

response.text: Priya will draft the pricing page by Friday, Marcus will escalate his SSO issue, and the mobile launch is postponed to November for QA.
